grammar.q: When I got to the airport, my flight ___.
She was nervous because she ___ never spoken in public before. (had)
answer: had

grammar.q: By the time we arrived, the guests already left.
answer: By the time we arrived, the guests had already left.

grammar.instruction_tr: İki cümleyi [en:by the time] ile birleştir; önce olan için past perfect kullan
grammar.q: Everyone went home. Then I finished the report.
answer: By the time I finished the report, everyone had gone home.
By the time I finished the report, everyone had already gone home.
Everyone had gone home by the time I finished the report.
Everyone had already gone home by the time I finished the report.
grammar.explain_tr: Önce olan eylem (eve gitmek) past perfect ile anlatılır: [en:had gone].

grammar.instruction_tr: [en:Why] ile soru cümlesi yap
grammar.q: The server had stopped working.
answer: Why had the server stopped working?
grammar.explain_tr: Past perfect sorusunda [en:had] öznenin önüne geçer: [en:Why had … stopped?]

grammar.q: Kelimeleri doğru sıraya koy:
answer: The meeting had already started when I joined the call.
When I joined the call, the meeting had already started.
grammar.explain_tr: Toplantı benim katılmamdan önce başlamıştı → [en:had already started].

grammar.q: Kelimeleri doğru sıraya koy:
answer: She had never led a team before this project.
Before this project, she had never led a team.
grammar.explain_tr: Geçmişteki bir andan öncesini anlatmak için [en:had never] + V3 kullanılır.

grammar.q: By the time I got to the meeting room, the others ___ the main points. (discuss)
answer: had discussed
had already discussed
had been discussing
grammar.explain_tr: [en:By the time] + past simple, ana cümlede past perfect: [en:had discussed].

grammar.q: I ___ for this company for six years.
How long have you ___ waiting? (be)
answer: been

grammar.q: I've been knowing her since primary school.
answer: I've known her since primary school.
I have known her since primary school.

grammar.instruction_tr: Tek cümle yap: present perfect continuous ve [en:since] kullan
grammar.q: We started using the new software in March. We are still using it.
answer: We have been using the new software since March.
We've been using the new software since March.
Since March, we have been using the new software.
Since March, we've been using the new software.
grammar.explain_tr: Geçmişte başlayıp hâlâ süren eylem: [en:have been] + [en:-ing] + [en:since].

grammar.instruction_tr: Soru cümlesi yap
grammar.q: They have been working overtime this month.
answer: Have they been working overtime this month?
grammar.explain_tr: Soruda [en:have] öznenin önüne geçer: [en:Have they been working …?]

grammar.q: Kelimeleri doğru sıraya koy:
answer: How long has she been managing the sales team?

grammar.q: Kelimeleri doğru sıraya koy:
answer: I have been looking for a new job since the summer.
Since the summer, I have been looking for a new job.
grammar.explain_tr: Yazdan beri süren eylem: [en:have been looking] + [en:since].

grammar.q: I'm tired because I ___ to customers on the phone since eight o'clock.
grammar.explain_tr: [en:since] ile şimdiye kadar süren eylem → [en:have been talking].

Don't call at nine — I'll ___ driving to the airport. (be)
answer: be

By Monday I'll have finished all the tests.

grammar.instruction_tr: Olumsuz yap

answer: I will not be using the car tomorrow.
I won't be using the car tomorrow.

grammar.instruction_tr: Soru cümlesi yap
grammar.q: The team will have finished the testing by Thursday.
answer: Will the team have finished the testing by Thursday?
By Thursday, will the team have finished the testing?

grammar.q: Kelimeleri doğru sıraya koy:
answer: By next summer, we will have moved to the new office.
We will have moved to the new office by next summer.

grammar.q: Kelimeleri doğru sıraya koy:

On Friday, the director will be visiting our factory.
grammar.explain_tr: Gelecekte planlanmış, o anda sürecek eylem: [en:will be] + [en:-ing].

grammar.q: By the time the auditors arrive, we will prepare all the documents.
answer: By the time the auditors arrive, we will have prepared all the documents.
By the time the auditors arrive, we'll have prepared all the documents.
By the time the auditors arrive, we will have already prepared all the documents.
By the time the auditors arrive, we'll have already prepared all the documents.
By the time the auditors arrive, we will already have prepared all the documents.
By the time the auditors arrive, we'll already have prepared all the documents.
grammar.explain_tr: [en:by the time] ile o ana kadar bitmiş olacak iş → [en:will have prepared].

grammar.q: If they had invited me, I ___.
If I ___ taken that job, I would be living in Berlin now. (had)
answer: had

grammar.q: If I would have known, I would have helped.
answer: If I had known, I would have helped.
If I'd known, I would have helped.
If I'd known, I'd have helped.
If I had known, I'd have helped.

grammar.instruction_tr: Third conditional ile tek cümle yap
grammar.q: We didn't check the contract carefully, so we lost money.
answer: If we had checked the contract carefully, we wouldn't have lost money.
If we'd checked the contract carefully, we wouldn't have lost money.
We wouldn't have lost money if we had checked the contract carefully.
We wouldn't have lost money if we'd checked the contract carefully.
grammar.explain_tr: Geçmişte olmayan durum: [en:If] + [en:had] + V3, [en:would have] + V3.

grammar.instruction_tr: Mixed conditional ile tek cümle yap (sonuç şimdi)
grammar.q: I didn't save the file, so I have to write the report again now.
answer: If I had saved the file, I wouldn't have to write the report again now.
If I'd saved the file, I wouldn't have to write the report again now.
I wouldn't have to write the report again now if I had saved the file.
I wouldn't have to write the report again now if I'd saved the file.
If I had saved the file, I wouldn't have to write the report again.
If I'd saved the file, I wouldn't have to write the report again.
I wouldn't have to write the report again if I had saved the file.
I wouldn't have to write the report again if I'd saved the file.
grammar.explain_tr: Geçmiş koşul + şimdiki sonuç: [en:If] + [en:had] + V3, [en:would] + yalın fiil.

grammar.q: Kelimeleri doğru sıraya koy:
answer: If the supplier had delivered on time, we would have met the deadline.
We would have met the deadline if the supplier had delivered on time.

grammar.q: Kelimeleri doğru sıraya koy:
answer: If I had accepted their job offer, I would be a manager now.
I would be a manager now if I had accepted their job offer.
grammar.explain_tr: Mixed conditional: geçmişteki koşul ([en:had accepted]), şimdiki sonuç ([en:would be … now]).

grammar.q: If the meeting ___ so long, I would have caught my train.
grammar.explain_tr: Geçmişe dair koşulda [en:if] kısmı past perfect olur: [en:hadn't been].

grammar.q: She ___ be at work — I've just seen her at the gym.
He's very late. He ___ have missed the train. (olmalı)
answer: must

grammar.q: They might have went to the wrong office.
answer: They might have gone to the wrong office.

grammar.instruction_tr: [en:must] ile yeniden yaz
grammar.q: I'm sure the client has received our email.
answer: The client must have received our email.
grammar.explain_tr: Geçmişe dair güçlü tahmin: [en:must have] + V3.

grammar.instruction_tr: [en:can't] ile yeniden yaz
grammar.q: I'm sure he didn't write this report alone.
answer: He can't have written this report alone.

grammar.q: Kelimeleri doğru sıraya koy:
answer: The meeting must have been cancelled at the last minute.
At the last minute, the meeting must have been cancelled.
grammar.explain_tr: Edilgen geçmiş tahmin: [en:must have been] + V3.

grammar.q: Kelimeleri doğru sıraya koy:
answer: He might not have read your message yet.
grammar.explain_tr: Olasılık, olumsuz ve geçmiş: [en:might not have] + V3.

grammar.q: The office is dark and the door is locked. Everyone ___ gone home. (eminim, 2 kelime)
answer: must have
grammar.explain_tr: Kanıta dayalı güçlü tahmin: [en:must have gone].

grammar.q: The report ___ by Friday.
I'm having my car ___ tomorrow. (repair)
answer: repaired

grammar.q: The new road is building now.
answer: The new road is being built now.

grammar.instruction_tr: Edilgen (passive) yap
grammar.q: Someone should have checked these figures.
answer: These figures should have been checked.
These figures should have been checked by someone.
grammar.explain_tr: Modal + perfect edilgen: [en:should have been] + V3.

grammar.instruction_tr: Özne + [en:is said to …] yapısıyla yeniden yaz
grammar.q: It is said that the new manager speaks five languages.
answer: The new manager is said to speak five languages.
grammar.explain_tr: [en:It is said that …] → özne + [en:is said to] + yalın fiil.

grammar.q: Kelimeleri doğru sıraya koy:
answer: She is having her car serviced this afternoon.
This afternoon, she is having her car serviced.
grammar.explain_tr: Bir işi başkasına yaptırmak: [en:have] + nesne + V3.

grammar.q: Kelimeleri doğru sıraya koy:
answer: All the applications will have been reviewed by next Friday.
By next Friday, all the applications will have been reviewed.
grammar.explain_tr: Future perfect edilgen: [en:will have been] + V3.

grammar.q: The results are expected to announce tomorrow.
answer: The results are expected to be announced tomorrow.
It is expected that the results will be announced tomorrow.
grammar.explain_tr: Sonuçlar kendileri açıklamaz, açıklanır: [en:to be announced].

grammar.q: I wish I ___ more patient with my kids.
I wish I ___ sold my old flat. Prices have doubled! (had, olumsuz)
answer: hadn't
had not

grammar.q: I wish I can travel more.
answer: I wish I could travel more.

I wish I traveled more.

grammar.instruction_tr: [en:wish] ile geçmişe dair pişmanlık cümlesi yap
grammar.q: I accepted the first offer.
answer: I wish I hadn't accepted the first offer.
I wish I had not accepted the first offer.
grammar.explain_tr: Geçmişteki bir şeyden pişmanlık: [en:wish] + past perfect ([en:hadn't accepted]).

grammar.instruction_tr: [en:If only] ile şimdiye dair dilek cümlesi yap
grammar.q: We don't have enough staff in the IT department.
answer: If only we had enough staff in the IT department!
If only we had more staff in the IT department!
grammar.explain_tr: Şimdiye dair dilek: [en:If only] + past simple ([en:had]).

grammar.q: Kelimeleri doğru sıraya koy:

grammar.q: Kelimeleri doğru sıraya koy:
answer: I wish my manager would give clearer instructions.

grammar.q: I wish I ___ to the meeting yesterday. Everyone says it was really useful.

grammar.q: In spite of it was late, we kept working.
answer: Although it was late, we kept working.
Even though it was late, we kept working.
Though it was late, we kept working.

Despite the late hour, we kept working.

In spite of the fact that it was late, we kept working.

grammar.instruction_tr: [en:Despite] ile yeniden yaz ([en:-ing] kullan)
grammar.q: Although he had a lot of experience, he didn't get the promotion.
answer: Despite having a lot of experience, he didn't get the promotion.
He didn't get the promotion despite having a lot of experience.
Despite having had a lot of experience, he didn't get the promotion.
He didn't get the promotion despite having had a lot of experience.
grammar.explain_tr: [en:Despite]'tan sonra cümle değil, isim ya da [en:-ing] gelir.

grammar.instruction_tr: [en:Whereas] ile tek cümle yap
grammar.q: Our Ankara office is small. Our Istanbul office is very large.
answer: Our Ankara office is small, whereas our Istanbul office is very large.
Whereas our Ankara office is small, our Istanbul office is very large.
Our Istanbul office is very large, whereas our Ankara office is small.
Whereas our Istanbul office is very large, our Ankara office is small.
grammar.explain_tr: [en:whereas] iki durumu karşılaştırır ve iki cümleyi birleştirir.

grammar.q: Kelimeleri doğru sıraya koy:
answer: In spite of the high costs, the company opened a new branch.
The company opened a new branch in spite of the high costs.

grammar.q: Kelimeleri doğru sıraya koy:
answer: The old system was slow, whereas the new one is much faster.
Whereas the old system was slow, the new one is much faster.
The new one is much faster, whereas the old system was slow.
Whereas the new one is much faster, the old system was slow.
grammar.explain_tr: [en:whereas] iki zıt durumu bağlar: eski yavaştı, yenisi ise çok daha hızlı.

grammar.q: ___ the fact that the deadline was tight, the team finished early. (rağmen)
answer: Despite
In spite of
grammar.explain_tr: [en:the fact that] ile birlikte [en:Despite / In spite of] kullanılır.

answer: move

grammar.instruction_tr: [en:increase] fiili ve bir zarf kullanarak yeniden yaz
grammar.q: There was a dramatic increase in online orders in May.
answer: Online orders increased dramatically in May.
Online orders dramatically increased in May.
In May, online orders increased dramatically.
In May, online orders dramatically increased.

grammar.instruction_tr: [en:There was a slight fall in …] ile başlayarak yeniden yaz
grammar.q: Our costs fell slightly in the third quarter.
answer: There was a slight fall in our costs in the third quarter.
There was a slight fall in costs in the third quarter.
grammar.explain_tr: Fiil + zarf ([en:fell slightly]) → sıfat + isim ([en:a slight fall in]).

grammar.q: Kelimeleri doğru sıraya koy:

speaking.question_en: Tell me about a decision in your life or career that you regret or are proud of. What would have happened if you had decided differently?
speaking.instruction_tr: Hayatında ya da kariyerinde pişman olduğun veya gurur duyduğun bir kararı anlat; farklı karar verseydin ne olurdu? (third/mixed conditional)
speaking.focus: narrative tenses and third or mixed conditionals

speaking.question_en: What are the advantages and disadvantages of working from home? Give a balanced answer.
speaking.instruction_tr: Evden çalışmanın avantaj ve dezavantajlarını dengeli bir şekilde anlat ([en:although], [en:however], [en:despite]).

speaking.question_en: Imagine you are presenting your team's results. Describe one trend in your numbers and say what you expect by the end of the year.
speaking.instruction_tr: Ekibinin sonuçlarını sunduğunu düşün: rakamlardaki bir eğilimi anlat ve yıl sonuna kadar ne beklediğini söyle.
speaking.focus: presentation language, describing trends, future perfect

speaking.question_en: Describe a time when something went wrong at work or at school. What had happened before, and how did you deal with it?
speaking.instruction_tr: İşte ya da okulda bir şeylerin ters gittiği bir anı anlat: öncesinde ne olmuştu ve sorunla nasıl başa çıktın? (past perfect, hikâye anlatma zamanları)

speaking.question_en: Imagine a supplier wants to raise their prices by ten percent. What would you say to them to reach an agreement?
speaking.instruction_tr: Bir tedarikçinin fiyatlarını yüzde on artırmak istediğini düşün. Anlaşmaya varmak için ona neler söylerdin? (diplomatik dil, [en:if] / [en:as long as] ile koşullu teklifler)

speaking.question_en: How long have you been doing your current job or studies? What do you wish were different about it?
speaking.instruction_tr: Şu anki işini ya da eğitimini ne kadar zamandır sürdürdüğünü anlat ve neyin farklı olmasını dilediğini söyle. (present perfect continuous, [en:wish])
speaking.focus: the present perfect continuous and wish

writing.instruction_tr: Bir tedarikçiye resmî bir e-posta yaz: son teslimat geç geldi ve bazı ürünler hasarlıydı. Ne olduğunu açıkla, bunun işine etkisini anlat ve diplomatik bir dille bir çözüm (indirim ya da yeni teslimat) iste. En az 120 kelime.
writing.prompt_en: Write a formal email to a supplier: the last delivery arrived late and some products were damaged. Explain what happened, describe the impact on your business and ask diplomatically for a solution such as a discount or a new delivery.
writing.focus: narrative tenses, passives, linking words and diplomatic language

writing.instruction_tr: Müdürüne bir e-posta yaz: bir projenin neden planın gerisinde kaldığını açıkla. Şu ana kadar neler yapıldığını, neyin ters gittiğini ve yeni teslim tarihine kadar nelerin tamamlanmış olacağını anlat. En az 120 kelime.
writing.prompt_en: Write an email to your manager explaining why a project is behind schedule. Say what has been done so far, what went wrong and what will have been completed by the new deadline.
writing.focus: present perfect simple and continuous, passives and the future perfect

writing.instruction_tr: Katıldığın bir eğitim ya da konferans hakkında müdürüne kısa bir rapor yaz: neler oldu, neler öğrendin ve neler daha iyi olabilirdi? Olumlu ve olumsuz yönleri dengeli bir şekilde anlat. En az 120 kelime.
writing.prompt_en: Write a short report for your manager about a training course or conference you attended. Describe what happened, what you learned and what could have been better. Give a balanced view of the positive and negative points.
writing.focus: narrative tenses, could have / should have and linking words of contrast
